name: Spatial Data Readiness and Quality Assessment
seo_title: Spatial Data Readiness and Quality Assessment | Spatial Intelligence
title: Before you build on your data, know its condition
intro: Many platform, dashboard, and AI projects run into problems because of data quality. This assessment measures the quality of your data with a documented methodology and tells you where to focus improvement effort first.
card: Know where your spatial data stands: accuracy, completeness, consistency, and currency, with a prioritized improvement plan.
fit: You are preparing to launch an e-service or platform that depends on spatial data.
You are about to migrate your data to a new system.
You keep hearing complaints about errors or conflicts between layers.
steps: Together we define the datasets in scope, the quality dimensions, and the measurement rules.
We sample the data and run spatial, attribute, and temporal checks.
We compare the data against reference sources where available.
We calculate the indicators and analyze the root causes of the gaps.
We present the results and the improvement plan to your team.
receive: A measurement methodology you can reapply yourself
